text: For the leader. A psalm of David.
I The Lord answer you in time of distress;the name of the God of Jacob defend you!
May he send you help from the sanctuary,from Zion be your support. [AA]
May he remember [1] your every offering,graciously accept your burnt offering,Selah
Grant what is in your heart,fulfill your every plan.
May we shout for joy at your victory, [2]raise the banners in the name of our God.The Lord grant your every petition!
II Now I know the Lord gives victoryto his anointed. [AB]He will answer him from the holy heavenswith a strong arm that brings victory.
Some rely on chariots, others on horses,but we on the name of the Lord our God. [AC]
They collapse and fall,but we stand strong and firm. [AD]
Lord, grant victory to the king;answer when we call upon you.
